Demonstration Data

This is a public portfolio demo of a production Power BI custom visual built for an enterprise sales team. To keep the public version fully neutral:

  • The "doors" shown are fictional ice cream shops with fabricated reps, objectives, and sales figures. The real product industry is intentionally unrelated.
  • Competitor overlays are anonymized as Brand A and Brand B.
  • Any resemblance to real organizations or individuals is coincidental.
  • Every other interaction (drill-down, multi-state Ctrl+click, color modes, toggles) behaves the same as the live production visual.

Built by Westley Smith. See westleybsmith.com for more.
